en.joke: I asked an AI to write me a joke about dating apps. It produced a 500-word essay on human mating rituals in the digital age.
en.explanation: The AI gives an overly academic, literal response to a simple joke request, subverting expectations with dry, unhelpful information.

people.name: Oswaldo Sánchez
people.extract: Oswaldo Javier Sánchez Ibarra is a Mexican former professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper and a sports analyst for TUDN. He is highly regarded as one of the best goalkeepers in Mexican footballing history.
highlights: Mexican former professional footballer and goalkeeper.
Currently a sports analyst for TUDN.
Considered one of Mexico's best goalkeepers.

people.name: Don Preston
people.extract: Donald Ward Preston is an American jazz and rock keyboardist. He is best known for being a member of the original version of Frank Zappa's band The Mothers of Invention during the late 1960s. He continued to work with Zappa during the early 1970s following the band's split.
highlights: Member of Frank Zappa's The Mothers of Invention.
Continued working with Zappa in the early 1970s.

people.name: Jason Citron
people.extract: Jason Citron is an American businessman and entrepreneur best known as the co-founder and former chief executive officer of the social communication platform Discord. He is also the founder of OpenFeint, one of the earliest major social gaming networks for mobile devices.
highlights: Co-founder and former CEO of Discord.
OpenFeint was a major mobile social gaming network.
